header_note: Pipeline demonstration for the default ticker; not the team's Part 2 recommendation, which follows the company pick.
_comment: Demo fixture: one chosen move and two rejected alternatives, each tied by finding id to MRK rows that pass the numeric gate in out/MRK/findings_v3.jsonl. Case-appendix themes: Keytruda's 2028 US patent expiry and the subcutaneous formulation, Januvia and Janumet generics plus the Medicare negotiated price. The Terns and Verona acquisitions have no passing MRK finding in v3 to tie a portfolio-shift move to. Every parameter is cited (10-K page or verified table row through verified_tables.py) or labelled an assumption. The company pick is open between MRK, AMGN and GILD; this file is not the recommendation.

moves.name: Move Keytruda patients to the subcutaneous formulation before the US loss of exclusivity
moves.why: Keytruda's label is the broadest in its class (cited label lines) and its company-stated US compound patent ends in 2028; moving patients to the subcutaneous formulation before then retains revenue the IV biosimilars would take.

loe_month.note: replaced by the verified pipeline/loe_calendar.csv row (company-stated 2028, 10-K page)

uplift_y1.note: retention gained by contracting, year 1 (team input)

rebate_depth.note: extra rebate on retained volume (team input)

program_cost_annual.note: switch program and field support (team input)

switch_capture.note: share of patients on the subcutaneous formulation at LOE (team input; uptake not disclosed)

tax_rate.note: peer median TTM GAAP ETR: MRK's own TTM ETR lies outside [0, 0.40] (section 4.2 fallback rule)

moves.name: Sell Januvia through a cash channel at the TrumpRx price
moves.why: Merck's MFN agreement lists Januvia at $100 through TrumpRx, down from $330, and Januvia's label is narrower than its rivals'; a cash channel keeps patients as generics arrive.

share_moved.note: 10% of US volume to the cash channel (team input)

price_delta.note: cash net 30% below current net (team input)

channel_build_cost.note: one-time build; TrumpRx listing exists (team input)

baseline_delta_rev_annual.note: Medicaid MFN size not disclosed; no baseline erosion modeled (the finding is direction only)

loe_month.note: US exclusivity already ended (May 2026); no further LOE step inside the horizon

tax_rate.note: peer median TTM GAAP ETR: MRK's own TTM ETR lies outside [0, 0.40] (section 4.2 fallback rule)

moves.name: Reprice Janumet ahead of its Medicare negotiated price
moves.why: Janumet's Medicare price is set by negotiation from January 2027; a commercial cash channel limits the spillover of the negotiated price.

share_moved.note: 5% of commercial volume to the cash channel (team input)

price_delta.note: cash net 25% below current net (team input)

baseline_start_month.note: January 2027, month 3 after 2026-10-17 (the finding's IPAY date)

loe_month.note: US exclusivity already ended (May 2026); no further LOE step inside the horizon

tax_rate.note: peer median TTM GAAP ETR: MRK's own TTM ETR lies outside [0, 0.40] (section 4.2 fallback rule)
